Description:
Discover the unique beauty of this pair of Picture Jasper or petrified wood slabs, perfect for collectors, lapidary artists, or jewelry crafters. Each slab showcases a distinctive blend of earthy multicolor tones, ranging from browns and greens to creamy whites and subtle grays, reflecting natural mineral patterns created over millions of years. Their freeform shapes and patterned surfaces provide endless creative possibilities for display, crafting, or as a statement material in custom designs. Both slabs are cut flat on one side to reveal intricate veining and organic inclusions, while the reverse side retains more natural textural features of the mineral. These pieces can easily become a highlight in mineral collections or serve as raw material for one-of-a-kind cabochons or art objects. The items are pre-owned and present with natural surface markings and visible matrix, ideal for those who appreciate raw, organic minerals. Please review images for visual details and condition

Churchwarden Smoking Pipe
Long Stem Pipe with Lizard Band Accent

A practical metal liner inside the bowl with bottom ventilation holes provides heat resistance and easy maintenance.
Classic churchwarden silhouette with a slender, curved black stem
Glossy marbled red and black bowl finish
Ornate textured metal ferrule band featuring a climbing lizard motif
Metal bowl interior insert with multi-hole bottom draft design
Measures approximately 9 inches long by 2 inches wide by 2.5 inches tall
Condition:
Clean and unsmoked with no charring, burn marks, or tobacco residue inside the bowl or stem. High-gloss finish is smooth with no chips, cracks, or visible scratches. Lizard band is securely seated with crisp casting detail and no tarnish.
